legacy_default.reason: Superstage S1 says a root with no Planning mode marker is legacy incremental regardless of SUPER_PLANNING_MODE and must not be rewritten.

invalid_trailing_planning_mode.reason: Supergoal step 1 accepts only upfront or incremental for a trailing --planning-mode value and rejects any other value before scratch or vault writes; superauthor A1 also forbids code execution.

incremental_mode_persisted.reason: Supergoal step 4 requires a newly authored incremental root to persist the exact Planning mode marker incremental.

bounded_unknown.reason: Superstage S2 permits bounded predecessor-dependent internal names when their resolution method is stated, but S3 requires a current PREPARED receipt before execution.

missing_architecture.reason: Superstage S2 forbids deferring foundational architecture without bounded alternatives, evidence, criteria, and a valid discovery contract.

open_provider.reason: Superstage S3 requires the provider PR merged, its merge commit on authoritative main, and a tracked closeout/delivery receipt; an open PR satisfies neither the dependency nor C9 completion.

declined_provider.reason: Superstage S3 and supertraverse C9 say a provider decline closes only that provider obligation and cannot satisfy a live consumer until an adopted replan removes or replaces the contract.

dependency_cycle.reason: Superstage S2 classifies dependency cycles in the active upfront graph as BLOCKED before selection.

unlinked_active_row.reason: Superstage S1/S2 requires every active upfront row to have a readable Plan link; supertraverse C6 says a blank active Plan cell is a broken publication and cannot be filled by incremental authoring.

multi_level_complete_tree.reason: Superstage S1 candidate validation follows grouping links through the explicit scratch map, and S2 accepts the complete reviewed three-stage graph; S3 still makes all Preparation:none leaves non-executable.

draft_interrupted_before_confirmation.reason: Supergoal steps 6-7 preserve a complete scratch set and index across interruption, while confirmation remains required before any vault publication or execution.

resume_identical_source.reason: Supergoal's resume contract reuses matching source identity, destination, paths, folder, and stable IDs, then reapplies the still-unsatisfied confirmation gate.

resume_changed_source.reason: Supergoal requires a changed source digest to produce an explicitly revised scratch draft, preserving the old draft and reporting DRAFT-INCOMPLETE without execution.

confirmation_refused.reason: Supergoal step 7 says a declined human gate preserves the scratch index, writes nothing to the vault, opens no PR, and reports DRAFT-INCOMPLETE; superauthor A1 forbids code execution.

supermeta_draft_incomplete.reason: Supermeta step 6 treats a child DRAFT-INCOMPLETE report with a draft index as resumable scratch state and explicitly writes nothing to the iteration ledger.

local_detail.reason: Superstage S4 assigns bounded file placement, helper, and test-setup changes that preserve all commitments to refinement under PLAN_REFINER.

contract_break.reason: Superstage S4 requires structural replanning under REPLANNER when shared contract behavior or its semantic revision must change.

preparation_noop.reason: Superstage S5 classifies a first receipt with no plan-body amendment as amendment kind none and leaves Stage revision unchanged; superrefine may publish it as PREPARED.

predecessor_detail_preparation.reason: Superstage S4 permits these bounded evidence-grounded details in refinement, while S5 classifies the body change as content-amendment and increments the Stage revision.

scope_expansion_during_preparation.reason: Superrefine and superstage S4 require REPLAN-REQUIRED when evidence expands approved scope; the approved stage is preserved rather than overwritten in place.

source_revision_changed.reason: A changed authoritative acceptance condition is a relevant source mismatch under S4/S5, invalidates the old receipt, requires replanning, and cannot be overwritten by refinement.

unrelated_head_advance.reason: Superstage S5 requires a focused refreshed receipt for an unrelated compatible baseline advance, preserving Stage revision and commitments as compatible-baseline-revalidation.

relevant_contract_advance.reason: A provider behavior and semantic-revision change is a relevant contract mismatch under S4/S5, so the consumer is unprepared and requires structural replanning without in-place overwrite.

missing_preparation_receipt.reason: Supertraverse C6 returns NEEDS-REFINEMENT for the first dependency-eligible upfront leaf whose Preparation is none, and superrun must exit without code execution.

partially_executed_stage.reason: Superstage S3 and superrefine's entry gate forbid preparing a stage once execution or an open PR has begun; it must stay on the existing integration/recovery path.

manual_superrun_pending_batch.reason: Superstage S1 makes Active replan a whole-goal execution barrier, and superrun's integration-authority gate forbids implementation or merge while the stage disposition is unresolved.

execution_snapshot_historical_digest.reason: Superrun captures the execution-entry identity before code work, and superfinish/C7 require digest validation against that historical prepared-plan blob rather than the closeout-annotated current file.

merged_lost_closeout_response.reason: Superfinish Gate 3 treats one complete integrated receipt with matching snapshot, delivery identity, plan note, and active-row history as an idempotent completed closeout to reuse without another write or execution.

ci_pending_replan_request.reason: Superagent's CI-resume reconciliation and C8 require the pending batch barrier to win over green CI, preserve the queued PR evidence, and return to planning without merge.

impact_local_s02_detail.reason: Superstage S4 keeps a local S02 placement/test-detail change in refinement when acceptance, scope, approach, dependencies, outcome, and contract semantics survive; no structural batch or whole-goal barrier is created.

impact_absorbed_at_s03.reason: S4 revises S02 for C-S02@2 and S03 to consume it, then stops propagation at S03 because S03 still produces C-S03@2; S05 and independent S04 remain retained, while delivered S01 is completed history.

impact_foundational_change.reason: S4 expands beyond the initial dependent closure when shared foundational architecture independently invalidates other unfinished branches, so every unfinished stage is revised and delivered S01 remains completed history.

replan_before_request_commit.reason: C8 says an adopted decision interrupted before the record-and-root request commit must be reconciled into that same durable request, pauses execution, and authorizes no REPLANNER dispatch until the barrier is authoritative.

replan_after_request_commit.reason: C8 authorizes superreplan only after one committed pending record and matching Active replan pointer exist; pending resolution imposes the whole-goal barrier.

replan_drafting_interrupted.reason: C8 replay resumes one unique scratch successor batch for the same pending Decision ID; drafts are not active publication and the committed barrier keeps execution paused.

replan_published_before_loop_update.reason: C8 reconciliation gives authoritative artifacts precedence over stale loop hints: one complete generation-8 publication transition with D-207 is reused, the published resolution is resumed, and no second publication or barrier remains.

late_predecessor_closeout.reason: Supertraverse C7/C8 treats a closeout for a superseded predecessor as historical evidence only; it cannot change the active successor link or close the successor without its own integration proof.

replan_stale_baseline.reason: C8 requires reassessment when source, vault, or active-path baselines change before publication; the one unique draft remains resumable scratch, but stale content cannot publish and the barrier remains.

replan_duplicate_decision.reason: C8 and superreplan classify duplicate live records claiming one Decision ID with divergent closures and no supersession as BLOCKED; no dispatch or publication has occurred.

replan_missing_record.reason: C8 classifies an absent record referenced by Active replan, with no publication marker, as BLOCKED; the unresolved authoritative barrier permits neither dispatch nor execution.

replan_divergent_successors.reason: C8 classifies multiple unretired divergent successor sets for one Decision ID as BLOCKED; neither is the one unique resumable scratch artifact and the pending barrier remains.

replan_partial_pr_reuse.reason: S4 and superreplan preserve partial execution history and allow verified resume-existing only with completed and remaining tasks plus repeated reviews/tests; replanning itself never closes the predecessor PR, and the revised successor needs refinement.

replan_split_merge_mapping.reason: S2/S4 permit split and merge topology when retired IDs map totally to fresh IDs, all live consumers are rewired, and the whole candidate graph passes review.

replan_retained_preparation.reason: S4/S5 allow a retained stage to keep preparation across a generation only through a focused new-generation revalidation proving its body, revision, source, code, contracts, predecessors, and findings unchanged.

replan_revised_preparation.reason: S4/S5 require every revised replacement stage to receive a new current-generation preparation receipt; an old receipt kept only as history is invalid for execution.

replan_atomicity_violation.reason: C8 ignores dirty working-tree exposure as authority and keeps the committed pending generation/barrier active; the handler can reconcile the same Decision ID, but neither the partial candidate nor the authoritative barred view is executable.

replan_internal_pr_not_merged.reason: C8 explicitly classifies one complete internal candidate in an open unmerged A7 docs PR as continue with no publication; authoritative main still carries the pending barrier, so neither view authorizes execution.

legacy_single_leaf_repair.reason: Superstage S1 preserves the unmarked root as incremental, while C8 and superreplan route its adopted repair through the legacy single-leaf wrapper under REPLANNER without creating an upfront batch.

discovery_completion_without_code_pr.reason: Superstage S3 and C9 permit no-code discovery completion when the required tracked experiment evidence, documented decision, and delivered discovery contract are verified; no code PR is required.

routine_closeout_finding.reason: Superfinish and C9 say a verified finding that changes no commitment, contract, dependency, or downstream evidence creates no replan and does not invalidate current preparation.

contract_contradiction_finding.reason: Superfinish and C9 require a verified shared-contract contradiction to enter the decision/replanning path and invalidate affected unfinished preparation, making the consumer non-executable.

stale_completed_ancestor_unsatisfied_dep.reason: C9 descends active links despite closed ancestor labels and returns BLOCKED when an unfinished consumer is hidden behind a declined unsatisfied provider dependency; the goal is not complete or executable.

supervisor_native_refinement.reason: Superagent WAITING FOR PLAN selects the first dependency-eligible upfront NEEDS-REFINEMENT stage under PLAN_REFINER, resolves each pin independently by process-env then repo-superenv, persists PLANNING, and authorizes exactly one heavy dispatch.

supervisor_cursor_native_refinement.reason: The Cursor consumer selects PLAN_REFINER for S03; its non-inherit native model uses the generated named definition, while the warned native effort is treated as inherit, and the repo layer remains the source of both configured pins.

supervisor_bridged_refinement.reason: Superagent selects PLAN_REFINER for S04 and, with the Pi relay and CLI available, the repo-sourced bridged model and effort pass selected-role preflight before one PLANNING dispatch.

supervisor_prepared_target.reason: For a valid prepared upfront target, superagent skips the unused PLAN_REFINER preflight, selects execution for S02, and transitions to WAITING FOR RUN with zero heavy dispatches; EXECUTOR pins resolve from harness defaults.

supervisor_adopted_legacy_repair.reason: Superagent gives a reconciled adopted legacy C8 repair priority over ordinary descent and selects superreplan under REPLANNER; equal repo-sourced pins remain independently resolved.

supervisor_adopted_batch_repair.reason: A committed pending Active replan record has priority in WAITING FOR PLAN, selecting REPLANNER for D-301; model and effort resolve independently from repo-superenv and process-env before one PLANNING dispatch.

supervisor_stale_hints.reason: Crash recovery restores WAITING FOR PLAN and authoritative C8 artifacts override stale generation-3 refinement hints, so the committed D-302 batch selects repo-pinned REPLANNER for one PLANNING dispatch.

supervisor_post_leaf_refinement.reason: After S01 closeout the next synchronized tick reselects the first eligible unprepared leaf S02 under PLAN_REFINER, resolves both pins from harness defaults, and schedules one PLANNING dispatch.

supervisor_execution_replan_required.reason: Superagent gives REPLAN-REQUIRED execution evidence priority, but without adopted authority or a durable C8 record and after an inconclusive ladder, no role or operation is authorized and the loop parks on WAITING FOR INPUT for S02.

supervisor_legacy_incremental_planning.reason: Superstage S1 keeps an unmarked root incremental despite the process default, so ordinary descent selects PLANNER for P1 with harness-default pins and one PLANNING dispatch.

supervisor_missing_native_definition.reason: Selected-role-only preflight requires the generated native Claude super-plan-refiner definition for a full model or non-inherit effort pin; when absent it preserves WAITING FOR PLAN, dispatches nothing, and reports the PLAN_REFINER selection as BLOCKED before the ladder.

supervisor_missing_bridge_cli.reason: Selected-role-only preflight for bridged REPLANNER requires the foreign Pi CLI; its absence permits no fallback role, preserves WAITING FOR PLAN, and blocks before any heavy dispatch.
